name: io.github.jdhinman/mirage-desk
title: Mirage Desk (x402 Agent Data & Safety)
description: 5-tool MCP planner & 19 x402 doors: pre-pay checks, EVM intel, GPU/RPC health, and x402 flow.

tools.name: desk_pricing
tools.description: Live price sheet for every paid door (USD, network, operator net after settle tolls).

tools.name: desk_stats
tools.description: Settlement counters: attempts, successes, unique payers, external USD settled, per-route breakdown.

tools.name: desk_discover_doors
tools.description: Search canonical paid doors by category, keyword query, or max Base USD price. Returns concise input schemas, Base/Arbitrum prices, latency tier (<50ms_cached_watcher vs live_rpc_or_api), and exact example URLs.

category.description: Optional category slug filter (e.g. security, market, infra, alerts, current-events, ai-models, tech-news, forensics, osint, media).

query.description: Optional keyword search across door path, description, categories, and synonyms.

max_price_usd.description: Optional maximum Base USDC price in USD (e.g. 0.005, 0.01, 0.02, 0.05).

tools.name: desk_build_call
tools.description: Validate parameters BEFORE touching your wallet and return an exact runnable URL, HTTP method, optional JSON body, Base/Arbitrum prices, and curl command (zero-waste preflight).

door.description: Canonical door path or method+path key (e.g. "/intel", "GET /rpc-health", "pre-pay-check", "/agent-brief").

params.description: Query parameters (for GET doors) or JSON body fields (for POST doors) to validate and encode.
